metadata.dcterms:title: A link invariant from quantum dilogarithm
metadata.dcterms:creator: Kashaev∗, R.M.
metadata.dcterms:abstract: The link invariant, arising from the cyclic quantum dilogarithm via the particular R-matrix construction, is proved to coincide with the invariant of triangulated links in S3 introduced in [14]. The obtained invariant, like Alexander-Conway polynomial, vanishes on disjoint union of links. The R-matrix can be considered as the cyclic analog of the universal R-matrix associated with Uq(sl(2)) algebra.
